title: VASP CrI3 monolayer: ferromagnetic bands, spin-polarized and with spin-orbit
summary: Monolayer CrI3, a 2D ferromagnet, from two VASP runs: collinear spin-polarized and with spin-orbit coupling. The PAO Hamiltonian (Cr 3D 4S 4P 4D 5S 5P 5D, I 5S 5P 5D 6S 6P 4F) and the bands along G-M-K-G. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: CrI3 bands, collinear spin-polarized
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_nspin2/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_nspin2/ and CrI3_nspin2_VASP.png

steps.label: CrI3 bands with spin-orbit coupling
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_soc/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_soc/ and CrI3_soc_VASP.png
